class_bookings_waitlist_check.name: class_bookings_waitlist_check
class_bookings_waitlist_check.value: ("class_bookings"."status" = 'waitlisted' and "class_bookings"."waitlist_position" is not null and "class_bookings"."waitlist_position" > 0) or ("class_bookings"."status" <> 'waitlisted' and "class_bookings"."waitlist_position" is null)

invoice_line_items_tax_check.name: invoice_line_items_tax_check
invoice_line_items_tax_check.value:
("invoice_line_items"."kind" = 'tax' and "invoice_line_items"."tax_rate_millionths" is not null and "invoice_line_items"."tax_rate_millionths" between 0 and 1000000 and "invoice_line_items"."tax_inclusive" is not null)
    or ("invoice_line_items"."kind" <> 'tax' and "invoice_line_items"."tax_rate_millionths" is null and "invoice_line_items"."tax_inclusive" is null and "invoice_line_items"."tax_rate_id" is null)

invoices_number_check.name: invoices_number_check
invoices_number_check.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is null) or ("invoices"."status" <> 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."number" > 0)

invoices_period_check.name: invoices_period_check
invoices_period_check.value: "invoices"."kind" <> 'cycle' or ("invoices"."period_starts_on" is not null and "invoices"."period_ends_on" is not null and "invoices"."period_ends_on" > "invoices"."period_starts_on")

signed_links_resource_check.name: signed_links_resource_check
signed_links_resource_check.value:
("signed_links"."purpose" = 'pay_invoice' and "signed_links"."invoice_id" is not null and "signed_links"."member_id" is null)
    or ("signed_links"."purpose" = 'sign_waiver' and "signed_links"."member_id" is not null and "signed_links"."invoice_id" is null)
    or ("signed_links"."purpose" in ('update_card', 'onboarding') and "signed_links"."invoice_id" is null and "signed_links"."member_id" is null)

audit_events_actor_reference_check.name: audit_events_actor_reference_check
audit_events_actor_reference_check.value:
("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_events"."actor_device_id" is null)
    or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'device' and "audit_events"."actor_device_id" is not null and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null)
    or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_device_id" is null)
